Hi, I’m Chad.

Why I built this summit

Have you noticed the world is increasingly designed for consumption? I’m on a mission to redesign it for contribution and connection.

I created the We! Connect Cards, co-wrote Ask Powerful Questions, and have led 1,000+ events. The Connectors Summit started as a way to gather the smartest, most generous people I know: the humans designing the meetings, trainings, and events that shape how everyone else connects.

9 out of 10 of last year’s attendees said they’d be back. If this is your first year, welcome home.

What people say after the summit

Frequently Asked Questions

Who is this for?

Anyone responsible for gathering people: facilitators, trainers, L&D pros, educators, team leaders, and event organizers. It’s built for experienced connectors who want to sharpen their skills and for newer group leaders who want a practical toolbox.

I’m new to We and Me. Will I fit in?

Yes. Every year, first-timers join alongside returning alumni. As soon as you register you join the summit community, so you’ll know people before day one.

Where does it happen?

Online, on Remo, a platform built for small-group conversation. Exactly 0% of the summit happens on Zoom. Many past attendees say they got full value just from seeing how we run it.

How big is it?

Hundreds of practitioners attend, and you’ll never be in a group of more than 12. That’s why the summit sells out: we cap seats to protect the depth.

What if I miss a session?

Every session is recorded and posted the same day, with access for a full year. You’ll also get every resource and cheat sheet.

Can my organization pay?

Yes. Many attendees use professional development budgets. The checkout gives you a receipt you can submit.

What’s your refund policy?

If you don’t love it, we’ll give you your money back with our 100% satisfaction guarantee.
